title: SEC2: No efficiency issues
description:
SEC2 efficiency review complete:

1. Union sizing: wc_Sha3 union member does not increase struct overhead. Union already sized for wc_Sha512 (~360B); SHA3 variants use same struct regardless of digest size.

2. sess_reset pattern: Free + Re-init is correct for FIPS compliance. wc_Sha3_384_GetHash exists but doesn't fully reset state; Free+Re-init pattern ensures clean cryptographic slate required by FIPS 140-3.

3. kcapi_hash.c wrappers: Single-line trivial callees at sha3_384_sess_init/sha3_512_sess_init lines 248-258. Will inline with zero runtime overhead. Standard pattern matching sha256/sha384/sha512 wrappers.

Result: No efficiency issues found. All three checks passed.
